evals.prompt: Validate my idea: a mobile sleep coach for rotating-shift workers that times naps and caffeine from overnight heart-rate data. Two-person team, bootstrapped, React Native, 6-week timeline; it will charge $6 a month. (Use these Phase 3 findings as given. Phase 3 finds no near-identical product, no maintained open-source project that covers most of the idea, and a fragmented paid market at medium confidence: three paid sleep-coaching apps at $5-10 a month report about 300,000 subscribers combined, and a forum thread asking for shift-work sleep coaching has about 1,200 upvotes. The MVP needs raw overnight heart-rate data, which only one wearable maker exposes to third parties, through a partner programme that approves apps case by case; the user has applied and has no decision yet.
